scope: Vanuatu medical discovery — Vanuatu College of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: The World Directory of Medical Schools has a school-detail record for Vanuatu College of Medicine.

Vanuatu's government scholarship eligibility criteria directs students seeking a Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery to Fiji National University or other external routes, not to a verified local degree provider in the reviewed material.

holdReasons: No current official college website, programme page, admissions call, fee schedule, curriculum, teaching-language statement, clinical-training evidence or student-support record was located.
The World Directory record establishes that a school record exists; it does not supply enough current programme or commercial-admissions evidence for a public university page.
No current Vanuatu regulator or government document corroborating active delivery, programme accreditation or graduate-registration status was located.
nextAction: Locate Vanuatu College of Medicine's current official programme/admissions materials and the responsible regulator's approval/accreditation evidence before reconsidering this candidate.
